capstone.title: Your First Client Video
capstone.brief: Shoot and edit a full 2-minute video for a real or pretend small business: a short advert with a clear message, clean shots, good sound, captions, and a call to action at the end.
checks: Video is 1 minute 45 to 2 minutes 15 long
Has a clear message in the first 5 seconds
Shots are steady and well framed
Sound is clear and easy to hear
Captions are correct and easy to read
Ends with a clear call to action
deliverables: A short note on the sound setup
A note on what you would improve next time
